meta.title: Lily Calls the Museum
meta.textType: functional: a recorded phone message and a phone call

paragraphs: On Friday, December fourth, at four o'clock, Lily sat at the kitchen table. Mom stood at the stove and stirred a pot of soup. Lily had Mom's cell phone, a notepad, and a pencil. Teacher Kim asked her to book the museum visit. Lily felt a little nervous, so she read her questions again. "You can do it," said Mom. Lily pressed the number and put the phone to her ear.

First a recorded message played. Lily put the phone on the table, pressed the speaker button, and took her pencil. "Hello, this is the science museum." "We are open from Tuesday to Sunday, from nine in the morning until five in the afternoon." "A child's ticket is thirty baht." "For a group, please press one." The screen said "Science Museum", and the timer showed forty-five seconds. Lily wrote the days and the times on her notepad. Then she pressed one.

After a short song, a receptionist answered. Lily picked up the phone because she wanted to speak. "Good afternoon. Can I help you?" asked the receptionist. "Hello, I am calling for my class," said Lily. "How many children can come in one group?" "A group can have up to thirty children," said the receptionist. "We are twenty-four children and one teacher," said Lily. "We want to come on Saturday, December twelfth." "That is fine," said the receptionist, "and a teacher is free."

"How much do twenty-four children pay?" asked Lily. "Thirty baht each," said the receptionist. "So the price is seven hundred twenty baht," said Lily. "That is right," said the receptionist. "You can pay cash at the desk." "You get a group pass." "An assistant will meet you at the entrance at half past ten." "Guide Ann gives a talk at eleven o'clock." "Would you repeat the time, please?" asked Lily. "The assistant meets you at half past ten, and the talk is at eleven," said the receptionist.

Lily repeated each number and wrote it down. "Thank you very much," she said. "You're welcome, and see you on Saturday," said the receptionist. Lily put down the phone and read her notes to Mom. "Saturday, December twelfth," she said. "Twenty-four children, thirty baht each, and the teacher is free." "We pay cash, and we meet the assistant at half past ten." "Guide Ann gives her talk at eleven o'clock." "How much money do we need?" asked Mom. "Seven hundred twenty baht," said Lily. "I will tell Teacher Kim, and she will bring the money."
